name: Val
description: A human Pinnacle scout whose ship crashed on an unexplored jungle world after Kav scrappers attacked and who daily transmits a distress message.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kav scrappers send Val's ship crashing onto an unexplored jungle world.
timeline.quote: Val has transmitted this message daily ever since a fateful run-in with Kav scrappers sent her ship hurtling to the surface of an unexplored jungle world.
